messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Auto-escalation -> GPU pool hotpath-eu reporting sustained queue growth and 429s across tiered token buckets. Current queue depth: 48k; avg latency 1.9s -> now rising. Alerts: gpu_util=98%, autoscaler_rejected_scales=3. Incident created INC-2026-2149.
elaine: ack oncall, i'm OOO-wfh but jumping in. grabbing logs + assigning. @mike you oncall for eu today?
mike: yep oncall. seeing spike. looks like autoscaler failed to create new hotpath nodes due to quota. returning 403 from cloud provider on create.
priya: confirming: quotas for project-redwood-eu are at limit? which quota exactly?
omar: GPUs: nvidia-a100 count exhausted. quota report: used 128 / 128. requests in pending queue waiting for node attach.
jen: omg. customers hitting 429s. support queue shows top app 'chatbot-plus' with 6 customers complaining. need immediate mitigation to reduce user impact.
ops-runner: quick mitigation options: 1) reroute lower-tier traffic to cpu-backed fallback, 2) throttle non-critical tiers, 3) bump tokenbucket refill for premium temporarily. which do we want first?
mike: we tried reroute earlier but tier policies prevented fallback — premium had strict no-fallback. suspect misconfig in rate-tier mapping after yesterday's rollout.
priya: digging into ratepolicy: found override in deploy 2026-03-14 that set premium.token_bucket.capacity=500 and refill=5/s but global burst window is 30s -> effectively starved when queue grows.
elaine: that sounds wrong. policy should allow short bursts for premium. set a temporary exception?
omar: also autoscaler logs show repeated 'scale attempt denied: quota_exceeded' then a deadlock where tokenbucket prevents older low-priority requests from draining queue.
incident-bot: SYSTEM: On-call handoff requested by mike -> @elaine is now incident lead. Escalation level: P1.
mike: I'm going to open a cloud quota increase right now (ticket opened). but that takes time. doing short-term service configs.
priya: propose immediate actions: a) relax premium.token_bucket.capacity -> 2000 b) exempt hotpath-eu from strict no-fallback for 10m c) disable per-route ratecap for background analytics requests. anyone object?
jen: :thumbsup: do it. customers need relief.
elaine: do (a) and (b) now. (c) wait until we confirm no overrun. mike please coordinate quotas. omar please prepare a node pool resize fallback if quota approved.
ops-runner: applying patch to policy service... showing curl payload:
```
PATCH /v1/ratepolicies/hotpath-eu
{ "overrides": { "premium": { "token_bucket": { "capacity": 2000, "refill_per_sec": 50 } }, "fallback_enabled": true } }
```
ops-runner: patch applied -> policy response 200. new effective rates in 2s.
priya: verifying metrics: tokenbucket_drops for premium dropping from 30k/min to 2k/min. queue inflow rate still high but drain improved.
mike: cloud quota request stuck in pending. called provider ops, they may expedite.
omar: starting a temporary model-routing change to shift large-batch async workload to dedicated-cpu-backend: command:
```
redwood route update --route analytics-heavy --backend cpu-dedicated --grace 30s
```
priya: noticed autoscaler process is stuck in a deadlock loop: controller waiting on tokenbucket lease for scale op -> scale op blocked by rate limits. I'm going to restart autoscaler controller to break the cycle.
elaine: do it, but warn: that will briefy make scaling decisions pause. do in short window.
priya: restarting...
incident-bot: DEPLOY-BOT: Restarting service=autoscaler-controller instance set=eu-stage.
priya: restart complete, controller health green. seeing immediate scale attempt succeed (created 4 nodes).
mike: nodes came up but attaching failed for 2 due to image-pull rate limit; provider returned 429 for container registry. working with infra.
jen: customer updates: support posted banner and opened CS tickets: we have a 50% degrad for some tenant calls.
ops-runner: temporary traffic-routing plan: shift non-real-time batch to a cold pool and limit premium concurrent per-tenant to 3 requests. applying via rate-limiter:
```
POST /v1/limits/apply
{ "scope":"hotpath-eu","concurrent_limit_per_tenant":3 }
```
ops-runner: applied. concurrent usage dropped by 35% within 60s.
priya: token bucket tuning summary so far: premium capacity -> 2000, refill 50/s, global-burst-window still 30s. This reduced immediate drops but we need proper tuning: consider refill proportional to recent avg token consumption per tenant and allow burst factor 4x.
omar: quota update: provider granted soft quota increase +20 GPUs pending billing confirmation. once billing clears we can scale more.
mike: any sign of leak or runaway from background jobs? logs show a misconfigured batch job from partner-integ that retries aggressively. I've paused the job.
elaine: good catch. pausing partner job removed ~8k requests/min. queue stabilized.
incident-bot: NOTE: Pager duty escalation to infra-team at 2149991258.
omar: infra confirmed registry limit issue cleared; image pulls now succeed. new nodes finishing bootstrap.
priya: metrics at 2149991320: queue depth 6k -> down from 48k. 429 rate for premium fell from 18% -> 0.8%.
jen: support: customers reporting recovery, some still seeing slow responses. CS to follow up with affected tenants.
elaine: status update to execs in 10m. I'll prepare blameless postmortem draft after incident. main root causes preliminary: 1) quota exhausted for GPU pool, 2) tokenbucket/ratepolicy misconfiguration from recent deploy that tightened premium bucket, 3) autoscaler deadlock interplay with tokenbucket lease ordering, 4) aggressive retrying batch job.
mike: next actions: - revert the risky deploy change in staging + create a canary check for tokenbucket config diffs - add guard in autoscaler to avoid scale ops waiting on rate limiter lease - put cloud quota monitor alerts earlier.
priya: creating follow-up issues: RT-314 ratepolicy-cfg-validators, INF-221 autoscaler-lease-order-fix, OPS-98 quota-alerts.
jen: support to run customer-impact sweep and prioritize top 5 tenants for credits.
elaine: thanks everyone. incident declared resolved at 2149991402. will publish incident timeline and assign postmortem owners. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: INC-2026-2149 resolved. timeline and links: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-2149
